title: Quest giver
wikitext:
'''Quest givers''' are [[NPC]]s that provide [[quest]]s for players. When the quests are completed, the quest giver will usually bestow [[XP]], or, if the character is the maximum level obtainable, money. Sometimes, quest givers will include an item or two as a token of their thanks. Questgiving NPCs will not usually attack [[monsters]] or the opposing [[faction]] unless they have been attacked first.
